purpose: Centralized configuration for the badminton commentary scraper, holding file paths, column contracts, yt-dlp throttle settings, stage-specific thresholds (chunk windows, LLM model choices, timeouts), and rate-limiting parameters. Every scraper stage imports from here so that output layout, CSV schema, API rate limits, and neural-model values live in one place.

public_api.name: CANDIDATES_CSV
public_api.role: Path to the main candidate-video index file (stages 1, 3)

public_api.name: CANDIDATES_COLUMNS
public_api.role: Fixed column order for candidates.csv; includes video_id, url, title, keep flag, and triage_verdict

public_api.name: SUBSTREAM_MATCH
public_api.role: String constant 'match' for videos tagged as match recordings

public_api.name: SUBSTREAM_INSTRUCTIONAL
public_api.role: String constant 'instructional' for coach-review or instructional videos

public_api.name: SEARCH_TERMS
public_api.role: Dictionary of search-term families keyed by substream, seeding YouTube searches

public_api.name: YTDLP_THROTTLE_ARGS
public_api.role: Build yt-dlp command-line flags (--sleep-requests, --limit-rate, --retries) shared by stages 1–2 to avoid IP bans

public_api.name: check_ytdlp
public_api.role: Validate yt-dlp is installed and in PATH before any scraper stage runs

public_api.name: ensure_dirs
public_api.role: Create scrape output directories (SCRAPE_DIR, VIDEOS_DIR, TRANSCRIPTS_DIR, CHUNKS_DIR, MASKS_DIR) if missing

public_api.name: read_candidates
public_api.role: Load candidates.csv into a list of row dictionaries for consumption by stages 2 and 3

public_api.name: write_candidates
public_api.role: Write rows to candidates.csv using the fixed CANDIDATES_COLUMNS header (stage 1 initial write and stage 3 rewrite with keep flag)
